title: Worst dream
description: Wake up from death instead of just dying
body:
**Heads-up:**
This mod toggles keepInventory and doInstantRespawn on by itself, you WILL lose your items if you didn't sleep in the last 2 days

This datapack allows you to wake up from a bad dream (after you die) aslong as you had slept in the last 2 days. When you wake up from such a dream, you will have a cold shiver in the night thunder.

This is my first datapack ever, so there might be some bugs
